tldr: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake in eastern Indonesia resulted in at least 38 fatalities and widespread panic.
Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon killed nine people, including three children, marking the highest death toll since June.
Concerns were noted in the market due to the flashing "Hindenburg Omen" and a significant talent exodus from OpenAI ahead of its IPO.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: The first test flight of the largest all-electric aircraft successfully used only $5 of electricity, as a venture aims to develop hybrid-electric commercial aircraft.
A critical vulnerability actively exploited gives attackers full control of Macs, allowing remote hackers to log in without a password through a screen-sharing bug.

Google's new "Camera Looks" feature, exclusive to the Pixel 11 series, processes image data at the sensor level to produce photos that mimic the style of older digital cameras, moving away from a typical "smartphone" look.

world.summary: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia, killing at least 38 people and prompting thousands to seek higher ground due to a now-lifted tsunami warning.
Nine people, including three children and two women, were killed in Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon, making it the worst toll since a lull in hostilities in June.
China is reportedly exploring the possibility of blockading Taiwan in a manner similar to Iran's actions in the Strait of Hormuz, raising new potential threats amidst current global conflicts.
